_help: The bus catalogue. makers: the manufacturer as the .bus files write it -> its name in the game. types: a model as the .bus files write it (manufacturer | type name) -> its model name in the game, the rest of the name as the variant (engine, gearbox ...), and ignore = left out of Career Mode's dealership by default. models: size (MINI, MIDI, MAXI, MEGA), class (City, Intercity, Long-distance, Double-decker, Minibus) and the years built (to = 0: still built). Edit it in the launcher (Settings > Bus catalogue) rather than by hand.
